scope: Root-owned event queue lifetime across encounter boundaries; applied healing-over-time and periodic class healing/mana recovery; existing cast, attack, projectile, damage-over-time and resource deadlines share that storage.

comparison.normalization: Absent and empty hots/periodicClass containers are equivalent; nonempty effects are fully compared.
comparison.result: All other snapshot fields match the pre-change version, including RNG, resources, logs, deaths and assets

behaviorChanges: Dead recipients lose pending persistent recovery effects; applied effects can continue after source death while that source remains present
Empty periodic containers are no longer allocated every rule step
Encounter completion preserves persistent recovery events and queue clock/sequence; it retires encounter-local timers
Effects remain present between their final pulse and a later expiry deadline
limitations: The 75 snapshots are regression evidence for these scenarios, not all encounters or mechanics
Arena still has two team execution contexts and battleground still uses its simplified combat path
Enemy-applied periodic auras, ground effects, global regeneration, aura expiry and boss timers require further migration
Outer 100ms progression, unit traversal and AI observation remain
No new full browser matrix or target-server end-to-end capacity validation under this ruleset hash
Local benchmark has no PostgreSQL, real WebSocket or capacity/speedup claim
